rationale: The validate_failed cluster shows confusion around validation results and rule enforcement. The current cheat-sheet is sparse and lacks guidance on interpreting validation output (exit codes, warning levels, strict mode). Expanding it with a more complete rule table and clarifying the behaviour of --strict will reduce misinterpretation of '✔ Validation passed' as a failure and help models correctly diagnose when actual rule breaches occur.
expected_effect: The model will correctly interpret `✔ Validation passed` as success with optional warning counts. It will not misinterpret a clean validation as a failure, and it will understand when to use `--strict` to escalate warnings. This should resolve the validate_failed confusion observed in the cluster.
regression_risk: Minimal – the changes only add missing rule information and clarification of output and strict mode. No existing content is removed or contradicted, so the passing tasks (t01‑t03) should remain unaffected.
